G4100.def:
πιστεύω, 
[in LXX chiefly for אמן hi. ;] 
__1. intrans., to have faith (in), to believe; in cl., with accusative, dative, in NT also with prep, (on the significance of the various constructions, see M, Pr., 67f.; Vau. on Romains 4:5; Ellic. on 1 Timothée 1:16; Abbott, JV, 19-80): absol., Matthieu 24:23, 26 Marc 13:21, 1 Corinthiens 11:18; with accusative of thing(s), Actes 13:41, 1 Corinthiens 13:7; with dative of person(s) (to believe what one says), Mrk.16:[13, 14], 1 Jean 4:1; τ. ψεύδει, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:11; περί . . . ὅτι, Jean 9:18; esp. and most frequently with reference to religious belief: absol., Matthieu 8:13, Marc 5:36, Luc 8:50, Jean 11:40, al.; before ὅτι, Matthieu 9:28, al.; with dative (see supr., and cf. DB, i, 829a), Jean 3:12 5:24 6:30 8:31, Actes 16:34, Galates 3:6" (LXX), 2 Timothée 1:12, 1 Jean 5:10, al.; with prep., (expressing personal trust and reliance as distinct from mere credence or belief; see M, Pr., l.with; DB, i, 829b), to believe in or on: ἐν (Psa.77 (78):22, al.), Marc 1:15 (see Swete, in l.); εἰς, Matthieu 18:6, Jean 2:11 (see Westc., in l.), and freq., Actes 10:43 19:4, Romains 10:14, Galates 2:16, Philippiens 1:29, I Jean 5:10, 1 Pierre 1:8; εἰς τ. ὄνομα, Jean 1:12 2:23 3:18, 1 Jean 5:13; ἐπί, with accusative, Matthieu 27:42, Actes 9:42 11:17 16:31 22:19, Romains 4:5; ἐπί, with dative, Romains 9:33 (LXX) 10:11 (ib.), 1 Timothée 1:16, 1 Pierre 2:6" (LXX) ; ptcp. pres., οἱ π., as subst., Actes 2:44, Romains 3:22, 1 Corinthiens 1:21, al.; aor., Mrk.16:[16], Actes 4:32; pf., Actes 19:18 21:20 (on Johannine use of the tenses of π., see Westc, Epp. Jo., 120). 
__2. Trans., to entrust: with accusative and dative, Luc 16:11, Jean 2:24; pass., to be entrusted with: with accusative, Romains 3:2, 1 Corinthiens 9:17, Galates 2:7, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:4 (see Lft., Notes, 21f.), 1 Timothée 1:11, Tite 1:3.

G4101.def:
πιστικός, -ή, -όν (πίστις), 
__1. having the gift of persuasion (Plat., Gorg., 455A). 
__2. 
__(a) of persons, faithful, trusty (Plut.); 
__(b) of things, trustworthy, genuine: νάρδος π., Marc 14:3, Jean 12:3.
†

G4102G.def:
πίστις, -εως, ἡ 
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;] 
__1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: Matthieu 8:10, Luc 5:20, Actes 14:9, Romains 1:8, 1 Corinthiens 2:5, 2 Corinthiens 1:24, 1 Timothée 1:5, al.; with genitive obj., Marc 11:22, Actes 3:16, Romains 3:22, Galates 2:16, Éphésiens 3:12, Jacques 2:1, al.; with prep., ἐν, Romains 3:25, Galates 3:26, Éphésiens 1:15, Colossiens 1:24, 1 Timothée 1:14 3:13, 2 Timothée 1:13 3:15, 2 Pierre 1:1; εἰς, Actes 20:21 24:24 26:18, Colossiens 2:5, 1 Pierre 1:21; πρός, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:8, Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative Hébreux 6:1; ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), 1 Corinthiens 16:13, 1 Corinthiens 13:5, 1 Timothée 2:15; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., Romains 1:5 16:26; ὁ ἐκ π., Romains 3:26 4:16, Galates 3:12; διὰ (τῆς) π., Romains 3:30, Galates 2:16, Philippiens 3:9. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: Actes 6:7 14:22, Galates 1:23 3:23 6:10, Philippiens 1:26, 27 Ju 3, 20, and perh. also Actes 13:8 16:5, Romains 1:5 and 16:26 (see supr.), 1 Corinthiens 16:13, Colossiens 1:23, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:2 (Lft., Notes, 125), 1 Timothée 1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8 6:10, 12, 2 Timothée 3:8 4:7 Tite 1:4, 13 3:15, 1 Pierre 5:9. 
__2. In passive sense, 
__(a) fidelity, faithfulness: Matthieu 23:23, Galates 5:22; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Romains 3:3; 
__(b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: 1 Timothée 5:12. (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. ICC on Romains 1:17, pp. 31ff.; Lft., Ga., 154ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515ff.; DB, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word)

G4102H.def:
πίστις, -εως, ἡ 
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמוּנָה ;] 
__1. in active sense, faith, belief, trust, confidence, in NT always of religious faith in God or Christ or spiritual things: Matthieu 8:10, Luc 5:20, Actes 14:9, Romains 1:8, 1 Corinthiens 2:5, 2 Corinthiens 1:24, 1 Timothée 1:5, al.; with genitive obj., Marc 11:22, Actes 3:16, Romains 3:22, Galates 2:16, Éphésiens 3:12, Jacques 2:1, al.; with prep., ἐν, Romains 3:25, Galates 3:26, Éphésiens 1:15, Colossiens 1:24, 1 Timothée 1:14 3:13, 2 Timothée 1:13 3:15, 2 Pierre 1:1; εἰς, Actes 20:21 24:24 26:18, Colossiens 2:5, 1 Pierre 1:21; πρός, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:8, Phm 5; ἐπί, with accusative Hébreux 6:1; ἐν τῇ π. στήκειν (εἶναι, μένειν), 1 Corinthiens 16:13, 1 Corinthiens 13:5, 1 Timothée 2:15; ὑπακοὴ τῆς π., Romains 1:5 16:26; ὁ ἐκ π., Romains 3:26 4:16, Galates 3:12; διὰ (τῆς) π., Romains 3:30, Galates 2:16, Philippiens 3:9. By meton., objectively, that which is the object or content of belief, the faith: Actes 6:7 14:22, Galates 1:23 3:23 6:10, Philippiens 1:26, 27 Ju 3, 20, and perh. also Actes 13:8 16:5, Romains 1:5 and 16:26 (see supr.), 1 Corinthiens 16:13, Colossiens 1:23, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:2 (Lft., Notes, 125), 1 Timothée 1:19 3:9 4:1, 6 5:8 6:10, 12, 2 Timothée 3:8 4:7 Tite 1:4, 13 3:15, 1 Pierre 5:9. 
__2. In passive sense, 
__(a) fidelity, faithfulness: Matthieu 23:23, Galates 5:22; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, Romains 3:3; 
__(b) objectively, plighted faith, a pledge of fidelity: 1 Timothée 5:12. (On the various shades of meaning in which the word is used in NT, see esp. ICC on Romains 1:17, pp. 31ff.; Lft., Ga., 154ff.; Stevens, Th. NT, 422, 515ff.; DB, i, 830ff.; Cremer, see word)

G4103.def:
πιστός, -ή, -όν
(πείθω), [in LXX chiefly for אָמַן ;] 
__I. Pass., to be trusted or believed; 
__1. of persons, trusty, faithful : Matthieu 24:45 25:21, 23 Luc 12:42, Actes 16:15, 1 Corinthiens 4:2 4:17 7:25, Éphésiens 1:1 6:21, Colossiens 1:2, 7 4:7, 9, 1 Timothée 1:12, 2 Timothée 2:2, Hébreux 2:17 3:2, 5, 1 Pierre 5:12, Apocalypse 2:13 19:11; of God, 1 Corinthiens 1:9 10:13, 2 Corinthiens 1:18, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:24, 2 Thessaloniciens 3:3, Hébreux 10:23 11:11, 2 Timothée 2:13, 1 Jean 1:9, 1 Pierre 4:19; before ἐν, Luc 16:10-12 19:17, 1 Timothée 3:11; ἐπί, with accusative, Matthieu 25:23; ἄχρι θανάτου, Apocalypse 2:10; ὁ μάρτυς ὁ π., Apocalypse 1:5; id. καὶ ἀληθινός, Apocalypse 3:14. 
__2. Of things, trustworthy, reliable, sure: Actes 13:34, 1 Timothée 1:15 3:1 4:9, 2 Timothée 2:11, Tite 1:9 3:8, Apocalypse 21:5 22:6. 
__II. Act., believing, trusting, relying: Actes 16:1, 2 Corinthiens 6:15, Galates 3:9, 1 Timothée 4:10 5:16 6:2, Tite 1:6, Apocalypse 17:14; pl., Actes 10:45, 1 Timothée 4:3 4:12; opposite to ἄπιστος, Jean 20:27; π. εἰς θεόν, 1 Pierre 1:21; π. ποιεῖν, III Jn 5. 
(On the difficulty of choosing in some cases between the active and the passive meaning, see Lft., Gal., 157.) †

G4104.def:
πιστόω, -ῶ
(πιστός), [in LXX chiefly for אָמֵן ni. ;] 
to make trustworthy (Thuc., 3Ki.1:36), hence, to establish (1 Chroniques 17:14). Pass. and mid., to be assured of: with accusative of thing(s), 2 Timothée 3:14.†

G4105.def:
πλανάω, -ῶ
(πλάνη), [in LXX chiefly for תָּעָה ;] 
to cause to wander, lead astray. Pass., to go astray, wander: Matthieu 18:12-13 Hébreux 11:38, 1 Pierre 2:25 (cf. Ésaïe 53:6). Metaphorical, to lead astray, deceive: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 24:4-5, 11 24:24, Marc 13:5-6, Jean 7:12, 2 Timothée 3:13; 1 Jean 1:8 Jn 2:26 Jn 3:7, Apocalypse 2:20 12:9 13:14 19:20 20:3, 8 20:10; pass., to be led astray, to err: Matthieu 22:29, Marc 12:24, 27, Luc 21:8, Jean 7:47, 2 Timothée 3:13, Tite 3:3, Hébreux 5:2, 2 Pierre 2:15, Apocalypse 18:23; τ. καρδίᾳ, Hébreux 3:10; ἀπὸ τ. ἀληθείας, Jacques 5:19;μὴ πλανᾶσθε, 1 Corinthiens 6:9 15:33, Galates 6:7. Jacques 1:16 (cf. ἀπο-πλανάω).†

G4106.def:
πλάνη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Proverbes 14:8 (מִרְמָה), Wis.1:12, al ;] 
a wandering. Metaphorical, a going astray, an error (in NT always with respect to morals or religion): Matthieu 27:64, Romains 1:27, Éphésiens 4:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:3, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:11, Jacques 5:20, 2 Pierre 2:18 3:17 3:1-18; 1 Jean 4:6, Ju 11.†

G4107.def:
πλανήτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλανάω), [in LXX: Osée 9:17 (נָדַד) * ;] 
= πλάνης, a wanderer: ἀστέρες π. (cl. planets), wandering stars, Ju 13 (WH, mg., -τες).†

G4108.def:
πλάνος, -ον 
[in LXX: Job 19:4 (מְשׁוּגָה), Jérémie 23:32 * ;] 
__1. wandering. 
__2. leading astray, deceiving: πνεύματα π., 1 Timothée 4:1. As subst., ὁ π., a deceiver, impostor: Matthieu 27:63, 2 Corinthiens 6:8 6:1-18 2 Jean 1:7.†

G4109.def:
πλάξ, -ακός, ἡ 
[in LXX for לוּחַ ;] 
anything flat and broad. 
__1. a plain (poët.). 
__2. In late writers (Luc., al.), a flat stone, a tablet: 2 Corinthiens 3:3, Hébreux 9:4.†

G4110.def:
πλάσμα, -τος, τό
(πλάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for יֵצֶר ;] 
that which is moulded or formed : Romains 9:20 (LXX).†

G4111.def:
πλάσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַר ;] 
to form, mould: Romains 9:26 (LXX), 1 Timothée 2:13.†

G4112.def:
πλαστός, -ή, -όν
(πλάσσω), 
__1. formed, moulded (Hes., Plat., al.). 
__2. Metaphorical, made up, fabricated, feigned (Hdt., Xen., al.): 2 Pierre 2:3.†

G4114.def:
πλάτος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for רֹחַב ;] 
breadth: Éphésiens 3:18, Apocalypse 21:16; τ. π. τῆς γῆς (Habacuc 1:6, מֶרְחָב), Apocalypse 20:9.†

G4115.def:
πλατύνω
(πλατύς), [in LXX chiefly for רָחַב hi. ;] 
to make broad, enlarge, extend: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 23:5. Metaphorical (cf. Psaumes 119:32, al.), pass., ἡ καρδία, 2 Corinthiens 6:11; ὑμεῖς, 2 Corinthiens 6:13.†

G4116.def:
πλατύς, -εῖα, -ύ 
[in LXX for רָחָב ;] 
broad: Matthieu 7:13. As subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὁδός), 
[in LXX chiefly for רָחָב ;] 
a street: Matthieu 6:5 12:19" (LXX), Marc 6:56, WH, mg., Luc 10:10 13:26 14:21, Actes 5:15, Apocalypse 11:8 21:21 22:2.†

G4117.def:
πλέγμα, -τος, τό
(πλέκω), [in Aq., Th.: Ésaïe 28:5 * ;] 
what is woven or twisted (as basket-work, nets, etc.); a braiding (sc. τριχῶν, cf. 1 Pierre 3:3) : pl., 1 Timothée 2:9.†

G4118.def:
πλεῖστος, πλείων, see: πολύς.
πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, 
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;] 
__1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, Actes 11:21; ὄχλος, Marc 5:24; θερισμός, Matthieu 9:37; χόρτος, Jean 6:10; χρόνος, Matthieu 25:19; γογγυσμός, Jean 7:12; πόνος, Colossiens 4:13; δόξα, Matthieu 24:30; σιγή, Actes 21:40; pl., προφῆται, Matthieu 13:17; ὄχλοι, Matthieu 4:25; δαιμόνια, Marc 1:34; δυνάμεις, Matthieu 7:22, 
__2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): Matthieu 7:22, Marc 2:2, al.; with genitive partit., Matthieu 3:7, Luc 1:16, al.; before ἐκ, Jean 7:31, Actes 17:12; with art., οἱ π., the many, Matthieu 24:12, Romains 12:5, 1 Corinthiens 10:17, 33 2 Corinthiens 2:17; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), Romains 5:15, 19; neut. pl., πολλά: Matthieu 13:3, Marc 5:26, al.; accusative with adverbial force, Marc 1:45, Romains 16:6 (Deiss., LAE, 317), 1 Corinthiens 16:12, Jacques 3:2, al.; neut. sing., πολύ: Luc 12:48; adverbially, Marc 12:27, al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), Matthieu 26:9; with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, 2 Corinthiens 8:22; πολλῷ πλείους, Jean 4:41. 
Compar., πλείων
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater; 
__1. as adj.: Jean 15:2, Actes 18:2o, Hébreux 3:3; before παρά, Hébreux 11:4 (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., Actes 13:31, al.; with genitive compar., Matthieu 21:36; with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), Actes 4:22 24:11, al. 
__2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: Actes 10:32 27:12, 1 Corinthiens 10:5 15:6; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: 2 Corinthiens 2:6 4:15, Philippiens 1:14; πλείονα, Luc 11:53; πλειον, πλέον, Matthieu 20:10, 2 Timothée 3:9; with genitive comp., Mk 12:43, Luc 21:3; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, Matthieu 12:41; adverbially, Actes 4:17 20:9 24:4. 
__3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, Luc 9:13; with genitive comp., Matthieu 5:20; πλείω: with num., Matthieu 26:53. 
Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον
, __(a) prop., most: Matthieu 11:20 21:8; adverbially, τὸ π., 1 Corinthiens 14:27; 
__(b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., Marc 4:1.

G4119.def:
πλέον, see: πολύς.
πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, 
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;] 
__1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, Actes 11:21; ὄχλος, Marc 5:24; θερισμός, Matthieu 9:37; χόρτος, Jean 6:10; χρόνος, Matthieu 25:19; γογγυσμός, Jean 7:12; πόνος, Colossiens 4:13; δόξα, Matthieu 24:30; σιγή, Actes 21:40; pl., προφῆται, Matthieu 13:17; ὄχλοι, Matthieu 4:25; δαιμόνια, Marc 1:34; δυνάμεις, Matthieu 7:22, 
__2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): Matthieu 7:22, Marc 2:2, al.; with genitive partit., Matthieu 3:7, Luc 1:16, al.; before ἐκ, Jean 7:31, Actes 17:12; with art., οἱ π., the many, Matthieu 24:12, Romains 12:5, 1 Corinthiens 10:17, 33 2 Corinthiens 2:17; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), Romains 5:15, 19; neut. pl., πολλά: Matthieu 13:3, Marc 5:26, al.; accusative with adverbial force, Marc 1:45, Romains 16:6 (Deiss., LAE, 317), 1 Corinthiens 16:12, Jacques 3:2, al.; neut. sing., πολύ: Luc 12:48; adverbially, Marc 12:27, al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), Matthieu 26:9; with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, 2 Corinthiens 8:22; πολλῷ πλείους, Jean 4:41. 
Compar., πλείων
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater; 
__1. as adj.: Jean 15:2, Actes 18:2o, Hébreux 3:3; before παρά, Hébreux 11:4 (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., Actes 13:31, al.; with genitive compar., Matthieu 21:36; with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), Actes 4:22 24:11, al. 
__2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: Actes 10:32 27:12, 1 Corinthiens 10:5 15:6; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: 2 Corinthiens 2:6 4:15, Philippiens 1:14; πλείονα, Luc 11:53; πλειον, πλέον, Matthieu 20:10, 2 Timothée 3:9; with genitive comp., Mk 12:43, Luc 21:3; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, Matthieu 12:41; adverbially, Actes 4:17 20:9 24:4. 
__3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, Luc 9:13; with genitive comp., Matthieu 5:20; πλείω: with num., Matthieu 26:53. 
Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον
, __(a) prop., most: Matthieu 11:20 21:8; adverbially, τὸ π., 1 Corinthiens 14:27; 
__(b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., Marc 4:1.

G4120.def:
πλέκω 
[in LXX: Exode 28:14 (עֲבֹת), Ésaïe 28:5 (צְפִירָה)* ;] 
to plait, twist, weave: Matthieu 27:29, Marc 15:17, Jean 19:2.†

G4121.def:
πλεονάζω
(πλέον), [in LXX for עֲדַף, רָבָה, etc. ;] 
__I. Intrans. 
__1. Of persons; 
__(a) to abound in (Arist.); 
__(b) to superabound: 2 Corinthiens 8:15 (LXX). 
__2. Of things, to abound, superabound: Romains 5:20 6:1, 2 Corinthiens 4:15, Philippiens 4:17, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:3, 2 Pierre 1:8. 
__II. Trans. (Nombres 26:54, Psaumes 71:21; not cl, see Lft., Notes, 48 f.), to make to abound: 1 Thessaloniciens 3:12 (cf. ὑπερ-πλεονάζω).†
SYN.: περισσεύω, q.v

G4122.def:
πλεονεκτέω, -ῶ
(πλεονέκτης, which see), [in LXX: Habacuc 2:9, Eze.22:27 (בָּצַע), Juges 4:11 B* ;] 
__1. intrans., to have more, to have an advantage (cl., with genitive of person(s)). 
__2. Trans., in late writers (see M, Pr., 65), to over­reach, defraud: with accusative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 7:2 12:17-18; ἐν τ. πράγματιι, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6 (see M, Th., in l); pass., 2 Corinthiens 2:11 (as also in cl.; see LS, see word).†

G4123.def:
πλεονέκτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλέον, ἔχω), [in LXX: Sir.14:9 * ;] 
= ὁ θέλων πλέον ἔχειν (see MM, xx), 
one desirous of having more, covetous: 1 Corinthiens 5:10-11 6:10 Éphésiens 5:5.†

G4124.def:
πλεονεξία, -ας, ἡ
(πλεονέκτης), [in LXX for בֶּצַע ;] 
the character and conduct of a πλεονέκτης. 
__1. advantage. 
__2. desire for advantage, grasping, aggression, cupidity, covetousness: Luc 12:15, Romains 1:29, 2 Corinthiens 9:5, Éphésiens 4:19 (see ICC, in l) Éphésiens 5:3, Colossiens 3:5, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:5, 2 Pierre 2:3 2:14; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6), Marc 7:22.†
SYN.: φιλαργυρία, avarice (see Tr., Syn., § xxiv)

G4125.def:
πλευρά, -ᾶς, ἡ 
[in LXX (frequently pl. as in Hom.) chiefly for צֵלָע ;] 
the side: Matthieu 27:49 ([[WH]] R, mg.), Jean 19:34 20:20, 25 20:27 Actes 12:7.†

G4126.def:
πλέω 
[in LXX, before εἰς, Jonas 1:3 (בּוֹא), I Esther 4:23, Ésaïe 42:10; before ἐπί, 4Ma.7:3; with accusative (poët.), Sir.43:24, 1Ma.13:29 (cf. Actes 27:2, Rec.) * ;] 
to sail: Luc 8:23, Actes 27:24; before εἰς, Actes 21:3 27:2, 6; ἐπί, Apocalypse 18:17 
(cf. ἀπό-, δια-, ἐκ-, κατα-, παρα-, ὑπο-πλέω).†

G4127.def:
πληγή, ῆς, ἡ
(πλήσσω), [in LXX chiefly for מַכָּה, also for מַגֵּפָה etc. ;] 
__1. a blow, stripe, wound: pl., Luc 10:30 12:48, Actes 16:23, 33, 2 Corinthiens 6:5 11:23; ἡ π. τ. θανάτου (RV, death-stroke), Apocalypse 13:3, 12; τ. μαχαίρας, Apocalypse 13:14. 
__2. Metaphorical, a calamity, plague: Apocalypse 9:18, 20 11:6 15:1, 6 15:8 16:9, 21 18:4, 8 21:9 22:18.†

G4129.def:
πληθύνω
(causal of πληθύω, to be full, πληθύς, Ion. for πλῆθος), [in LXX chiefly for רָבָה hi. ;] 
__1. trans., to increase, multiply: 2 Corinthiens 9:10 6:14" (LXX) ; pass., to be increased, to multiply: Matthieu 24:12, Actes 6:7 7:17 9:31 12:24; with dative of person(s) (Dan LXX TH 3:31(98) al.), 1 Pierre 1:2, 2 Pierre 1:2, Ju 2. 
__2. Intrans., to be increased, to multiply: Actes 6:1.†

G4130.def:
πίμπλημι 
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, also for שָׂבַע ;] 
trans. form in present and imperfect of πλήθω (intrans. in these tenses), which supplies the other tense forms; 
to fill: with accusative, Luc 5:7; with accusative and genitive, Matthieu 27:48; pass., Matthieu 22:10, Actes 19:29; of that which fills or takes possession of the mind : pass., with genitive, Luc 1:15, 41 1:67 4:28 5:26 6:11, Actes 2:4 3:10 4:8, 31 5:17 9:17 13:9, 45. Metaphorical (as in LXX for מָלֵא: Genèse 29:27, Job 15:32), to complete, fulfil: pass., of prophecy, Luc 21:22; of time, Luc 1:23, 57 2:6, 21-22 (cf. ἐμ-πίμπλημι).†
πλήθω, see: πίμπλημι 
SYN.: πληροφορέω, πληρόω

G4131.def:
πλήκτης, -ου, ὁ
(πλήσσω), [in Sm.: Psaumes 35:15 * ;] 
a striker, brawler: 1 Timothée 3:3, Tite 1:7 (Arist., Plut., al.).†

G4132.def:
πλήμμυρα, -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1) 
(πλήθω), [in LXX: π. γένεσθαι, Job 40:18 (23) (נָהָר עָשַׁק) * ;] 
a flood (of sea or river) : Luc 6:48.†

G4133.def:
πλήν 
adv., [in LXX for רַק, בַּד, אַךְ, etc. ;] 
__1. introducing a clause (= ἀλλά, δέ; "it is obvious that πλήν was the regular word in the vulgar language": Bl., § 77, 13), yet, howbeit, only: Matthieu 11:22, 24 18:7 26:39, 64 (M, Pr., 86), Luc 6:24, 35 10:11, 14 10:20 11:41 12:31 13:33 17:1 18:8 19:27 22:21-22, 42 (WH, mg. om.) Luc 23:28, 1 Corinthiens 11:11, Éphésiens 5:33, Philippiens 3:16 4:14, Apocalypse 2:25; π. ὅτι (Hdt., Plat., al.), except that, save that, Actes 20:23, Philippiens 1:18. 
__2. As prep., with genitive, except, save (cl.) : Marc 12:32, Jean 8:10, Actes 8:1 15:28 27:22.†

G4134.def:
πλήρης, -ες 
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא ;] 
__1. full, filled: Matthieu 14:20 15:37; with genitive of thing(s), Marc 8:19; λέπρας, Luc 5:12; metaphorically, of the soul: πνεύματος ἀγίου, Luc 4:1, Actes 6:3 7:55 11:24; πίστεως, Actes 6:5; χάριτος, ib. Actes 6:8; χ. καὶ ἀληθείας (where π. is indecl.; see M, Pr., 50; Milligan, NTD, 65, with reff. in each), Jean 1:14; δόλου, Actes 13:10; θυμοῦ, Actes 19:28; ἔργων ἀγαθῶν, Actes 9:36. 
__2. full, complete: μισθός, II Jn 8; σῖτος (π. prob. in­decl. here; see on Jean 1:14, supr.), Marc 4:28.†

G4135.def:
πληροφορέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Ecclésiaste 8:11 (מָלֵא) * ;] 
__1. to bring in full measure, hence, to fulfil, accomplish: Luc 1:1, 2 Timothée 4:5 4:17. 
__2. to persuade, assure or satisfy fully (so in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 82 f.; M, Th., 9): pass., Romains 4:21 14:5, Colossiens 4:12 (see Lft., in l). 
__3. to fill: Romains 15:13, L, mg. (Cl. Ro., 1 Corinthiens 5:4); metaphorically, pass., to be filled with, hence, fully bent on (Ec, l.with).†

G4136.def:
πληροφορία, -ας, ἡ
(πληροφορέω), 
full assurance, confidence: 1 Thessaloniciens 1:5; τ. συνέσεως, Colossiens 2:2; τ. ἐλπίδος, Hébreux 6:11; πίστεως, Hébreux 10:22 (cf. Lft. on Col., l.with; M, Th., 9).†

G4138.def:
πλήρωμα, -τος, τό
(πληρόω), [in LXX for מְלֹא ;] 
the result of the action involved in πληρόω (Lft., Col., 255 if.; AR, Eph., 255 ff.), hence, 
__1. in passive sense, that which has been completed, complement, plenitude, fullness (in Xen., Luc., Polyb., al., of a ship's crew or cargo, and by meton. of the ship itself) : Jean 1:16, Romains 11:12, 25 15:29, 1 Corinthiens 10:26" (LXX) Éphésiens 1:23 (AR, 42 ff.) Éphésiens 3:19 (AR. 87 ff.) Éphésiens 4:13, Colossiens 1:19 2:9; of time, Galates 4:4, Éphésiens 1:10; κοφίνων (σφυρίδων) πληρώματα, basketfuls, Marc 6:43 8:20. 
__2. In active sense (= πλήρωσις, as frequently in words of these formations, cf. κτίσις, and see MM, xx); 
__(a) that which fills up (but see Lft., l.with) : Matthieu 9:16, Marc 2:21; 
__(b) a filling up, completing, fulfilment: Romains 13:10.†

G4139.def:
πλησίος, -α, -ον
(πέλας, near), 
near, close by, neighbouring. As adv., πλησίον = πέλας, near: with genitive, Jean 4:5; with art., ὁ π., one's neigh­bour 
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ]: 
Luc 10:29, 36, Actes 7:27, Romains 13:10 15:2, Éphésiens 4:25, Jacques 4:12; ἀγαπήσεις τὸν π. σου ὡς σεαυτόν (Lévitique 19:18, LXX), Matthieu 5:43 19:19 22:39, Marc 12:31, 33, Luc 10:27, Romains 13:9, Galates 5:14, Jacques 2:8 (on the various senses of ὁ π. in OT, NT, see DB, iii, 511; DCC, ii, 240 f.).†

G4140.def:
πλησμονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(πίμπλημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂבֵעַ and cognate forms ;] 
a filling up, satiety: πρὸς π. σαρκός (RV, against the indulgence of the flesh; but ICC, in l, for the full satisfaction of the flesh, op. cit., 276 ff.), Colossiens 2:23.†

G4141.def:
πλήσσω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi., ho. ;] 
to strike, smite: pass., Apocalypse 8:12 (cf. ἐπι, πλήσσω).†

G4142.def:
πλοιάριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πλοῖον), 
a boat: Marc 3:9, Luc 5:2 (πλοῖα, WH, txt., R), Jean 6:22-23 (πλοῖα, WH) Jean 6:24 21:8.†

G4143.def:
πλοῖον, -ον, τό
(πλέω), [in LXX chiefly for אֳנִיָּה ;] 
a boat, also (= obsolete ναῦς) a ship: Matthieu 4:21-22, and frequently in Gosp. and Ac, Jacques 3:4, Apocalypse 8:9 18:19.

G4144.def:
πλόος, πλούς genitive, -όου, -oῦ (and in late writers also πλοός, like νοός from νοῦς), ὁ 
(πλέω), [in LXX: Wis.14:1 * ;] 
a voyage: Actes 21:7 27:9-10.†

G4145.def:
πλούσιος, -α, -ον
(πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשִׁיר ;] 
rich, wealthy: Matthieu 27:57, Luc 12:16 14:12 16:1, 19 18:23 19:2. Substantively, ὁ π., Luc 16:21-22, Jacques 1:10-11; oἱ π., Luc 6:24 21:1, 1 Timothée 6:17, Jacques 2:6 5:1, Apocalypse 6:15 13:16; anarth., a rich man, Matthieu 19:23-24, Marc 10:25 12:41, Luc 18:25. Metaphorical, of God, ἐν ἐλέει (= cl., with genitive, dative), Éphésiens 2:4; of Christ, 2 Corinthiens 8:9; of Christians, Apocalypse 2:9 3:17; ἐν πίστει, Jacques 2:5.†

G4146.def:
πλουσίως 
adv., 
richly, abundantly: Colossiens 3:16, 1 Timothée 6:17. Tite 3:6, 2 Pierre 1:11.†

G4147.def:
πλουτέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;] 
to be rich, aor., to become rich: Luc 1:53, 1 Timothée 6:9; before ἀπό (Sir.11:18), Apocalypse 18:15; ἐκ, Apocalypse 18:3, 19; ἐν (= cl., with genitive, dative, accusative, cf. πλούσιος), 1 Timothée 6:18. Metaphorical, π. εἰς θεόν, Luc 12:21; of God, εἰς πάντας, Romains 10:12; aor., I became rich, 1 Corinthiens 4:8, 2 Corinthiens 8:9, Apocalypse 3:18; pf., I have become rich, Apocalypse 3:17.†

G4148.def:
πλουτίζω
(πλοῦτος), [in LXX chiefly for עָשַׁר hi. ;] 
to make rich, enrich: with accusative of person(s), pass., 2 Corinthiens 9:11. Metaphorical, of spiritual riches, with accusative: of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 6:10; before ἐν, pass., 1 Corinthiens 1:5.†

G4149.def:
πλοῦτος, -ου, ὁ and (in 2 Corinthiens 8:2, Éphésiens 1:17 2:7 3:8, 16, Philippiens 4:19, Colossiens 1:27 2:2; see WH, App., 158; M, Pr., 60) τό, 
[in LXX chiefly for עֹשֶׁר ;] 
riches, wealth: of external possessions, Matthieu 13:22, Marc 4:19, Luc 8:14, 1 Timothée 6:17, Jacques 5:2, Apocalypse 18:16; of moral and spiritual conceptions, Romains 2:4 9:23 11:12, 33, 2 Corinthiens 8:2, Éphésiens 1:7, 18 2:7 3:8, 16 Philippiens 4:19, Colossiens 1:27 2:2, Hébreux 11:26, Apocalypse 5:12.†

G4150.def:
πλύνω 
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבַס pi. ;] 
to wash (inanimate objects, esp. clothing): τ. δίκτυα, Luc 5:2. Fig., τ. στολάς, Apocalypse 7:14 22:14 (cf. Psaumes 51:4, 9 and see: ἀπο-πλύνω).†
SYN.: see: λούω

G4151G.def:
πνεῦμα, -τος, τό, 
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for רוּחַ ;] 
__1. of air in motion; 
__(a) wind: Jean 3:8; pl., Hébreux 1:7 (LXX); 
__(b) breath: π. ζωῆς, Apocalypse 11:11; π. τοῦ στόματος, figuratively, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:8 (cf. Ps 32 (33)6). 
__2. Of the vital principle, the spirit (Arist., Polyb., al.): Luc 8:55, Jean 19:30, Actes 7:59, al.; opposite to σάρξ, Matthieu 26:41, Marc 14:38, 1 Corinthiens 5:5, al.; to σῶμα, Romains 8:10, 1 Corinthiens 6:17 7:34, 1 Pierre 4:6; to ψυχή, Philippiens 1:27, Hébreux 4:12; τὸ π. καὶ ἡ ψ. καὶ τ. σῶμα, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:23 (M, Th., in l.); dative, τῷ π., in spirit, Marc 2:8 8:12, Jean 11:33 13:21, Actes 18:25, Romains 12:11, 1 Corinthiens 7:34, 1 Pierre 3:18, al.; of the human spirit of Christ, Romains 1:4, 1 Timothée 3:16. 
__3. spirit, i.e. frame of mind, disposition, influence: Luc 1:17, Romains 8:15, 1 Corinthiens 4:21, Gal 6:1, Éphésiens 2:2, 2 Timothée 1:7, 1 Jean 4:6, al. 
__4. An incorporeal being, a spirit: Luc 24:37, 39 Actes 23:8; π. ὁ θεός, God is spirit, Jean 4:24; πατὴρ τῶν π., Hébreux 12:9; of disembodied human beings, Hébreux 12:23, 1 Pierre 3:19 (ICC, in l.; DB, iii, 795); of angels. Hébreux 1:14; of demons or evil spirits, Matthieu 8:16, Marc 9:20, Luc 9:39, al.; π. πύθυωνα, Actes 16:16; πνεύματα δαιμονίων, Apocalypse 16:14; π. δαιμονίου ἀκαθάρτου, Luc 4:33; π. ἀσθενείας (Bl., §35, 5), Luc 13:11; π. ἀκάθαρτον, Matthieu 10:1, Marc 1:23, Luc 4:36, Actes 5:16; π. ἄλαλον (καὶ κωφόν), Marc 9:17, 25; πονηρόν, Luc 7:21, Actes 19:12, al. 
__5. Of the Holy Spirit, π. ἅγιον, τὸ ἅ. π., τὸ π. τὸ ἅ. τὸ π., π. (the article as a rule being used when the Spirit is regarded as a Person or a Divine Power, and omitted when the reference is to an operation, influence or gift of the Spirit; see WM, 151:5; Bl., §46, 7): anarth., Matthieu 1:18 3:11, 16 4:1, Marc 1:8 (Swete, in l.), ib.10, Luc 1:15, Jean 7:39, Actes 19:2, Romains 5:5, 1 Corinthiens 2:4, al.; with art., Matthieu 4:1 12:31, 32 Marc 1:10 3:29, Luc 2:26, Jean 7:36 14:26, Actes 4:31 5:3, Romains 8:16, al.; (τὸ) π. (τοῦ) θεοῦ, Matthieu 3:16, Romains 8:9, Éphésiens 3:16, 1 Jean 4:2, al.; τὸ π. τ. πατρός, Matthieu 10:20; π. θεοῦ ζῶντος, 2 Corinthiens 3:3; (τὸ) π. τοῦ κυρίου, Luc 4:18, Actes 5:9 8:39; τὸ π. Ἰησοῦ, Actes 16:7; Χριστοῦ, Romains 8:9; Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, Philippiens 1:19; τὸ π. τ. ἀληθείας, Jean 15:26 16:13, 1 Jean 4:6; λείγει (μαρτυρεῖ) τὸ π. (τὸ ἅγιον), Actes 21:11 28:25, 1 Timothée 4:1, Hébreux 3:7 10:15, Apocalypse 14:13; before τ. ἐκκλησίαις, Apocalypse 2:7, 11 17, 29, 3:6, 12, 22; ἐν τ. π., Luc 2:27; κατὰ πνεῦμα, Romains 8:4, 5; ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ π., Jean 3:5, διὰ πνεύματος αἰωνίου, Hébreux 9:14; ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:13, 1 Pierre 1:2; ἓν π., 1 Corinthiens 12:13, Éphésiens 2:18 4:4; ὁ δὲ κύριος τὸ π. ἐστιν, 2 Corinthiens 3:17; of that which is effected or governed by the Spirit, opposite to γράμμα, Romains 2:29 7:6, 2 Corinthiens 3:6. 
SYN.: νοῦς, which in NT is contrasted with π. as "the action of the understanding in man with that of the spiritual or ecstatic impulse" (DB, iv, 612); ψυχή — the usual term in cl. psychology—in NT, "expresses man as apart from God, a separate individual, π. expresses man as drawing his life from God" (DB, 1-vol., 872).

G4154.def:
πνέω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 147:7 (18) (נָשַׁב hi.), Ésaïe 40:24 (נָשַׁף), Sir.43:16, 20, Ep. Je 61, 2Ma.9:7 * ;] 
to breathe, blow: of the wind, Matthieu 7:25, 27, Luc 12:55, Jean 3:8 6:18, Apocalypse 7:1; ηῇ πνεούσῃ (sc. αὔρᾳ), Actes 27:40 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐν-, ὑπο-πνέω).†
αὔρα, a breeze : τ. πνεούσῇ (sc. αὔρᾳ), Actes 27:40.†

G4155.def:
πνίγω 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 16:14-15 (בָּעַת pi.) * ;] 
to choke: with accusative, Matthieu 13:7 (WH, mg.); imperfect (coniative), Matthieu 18:28; of drowning, pass., Marc 5:13 (cf. ἀπο-, ἐπι-, συν-πνίγω).†

G4157.def:
πνοή, -ῆς, ή
(πνέω), [in LXX chiefly for נְשָׁמָה ;] 
__1. a blowing, blast, wind: Actes 2:2. 
__2. a breathing, breath: Actes 17:25 (Genèse 2:7, al.).†

G4158.def:
ποδήρης, -ες
(πούς), [in LXX: Exode 25:6 (7) Exode 35:9 (חֹשֶׁן), Exode 28:4 Exode 29:5 (מְעִיל), Exode 28:27 (31) (אֵפוֹד), אֵפוֹד), Eze.9:2-3, 11 (בַּד), Zacharie 3:5 (4) (מַחֲלָצָה), Wis.18:24, Sir.27:8 45:8 * ;] 
reaching to the feet. of a garment (sc. χιτών, cf. Ex, Ez, ll. with; Xen., al.), Apocalypse 1:13 (for -η, LT7 read -ην; see M, Pr., 49).†
SYN.: στολή, see Tr., Syn., § 1

G4160G.def:
ποιέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX for a great variety of words, but chiefly for עשׂה ;] 
__1. to make, produce, create, cause: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 17:4, Marc 9:5, Jean 9:11, Actes 9:39, Romains 9:20, al.; of God as Creator (with accusative of person(s) also), Matthieu 19:4, Marc 10:6, Luc 11:40, Actes 4:24, Hébreux 1:2, al.; like Heb. עשׂה, absol. = ἐργάζομαι, to work, Matthieu 20:12 (cf. Ruth 2:19; so AV, but see infr.), Apocalypse 13:5, R, mg. (but see infr.); σκάνδαλα, Romains 16:17; εἰρεήνην, Éphésiens 2:15, Jacques 3:18; ἐπίστασιν, Actes 24:12; συστροφήν, Actes 23:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Luc 1:68, Actes 15:3; with nouns expressing action or its accomplishment, forming a periphr. for the cogn. verb: ὁδόν π. (cl. ὁ ποιεῖσθαι), to go on, advance, Marc 2:23; πόλεμον, Apocalypse 11:7, al.; ἐκδίκησιν, Luc 18:7, 8; ἐνέδραν, Actes 25:3; κρίσιν, Jean 5:27, Ju 15; ἔργα, Jean 5:36, al.; (σημεῖα), Jean 2:23 and freq., Actes 2:22, al.; so also mid. ποιεῖσθαι: μονήν, Jean 14:23; πορείαν, Luc 13:22; κοινωνίαν, Romains 15:26; of food, to make ready, prepare: δεῖπνον, Marc 6:21, al.; δοχήν, Luc 5:29 14:13; γάμους, Matthieu 22:2; of time, to spend (cl.): ὥραν, Matthieu 20:12, RV (but see supr. and cf. McN, in l.); μῆνας, Apocalypse 13:5, R, txt. (cf. Swete, in l.; but see supr.); ἐνιαυτόν, Jacques 4:13; with accusative before ἐκ, Jean 2:15, al.; with accusative and accusative pred., Matthieu 3:3 12:16, Marc 1:3 3:12, Jean 5:11, al.; with adv., καλῶς, Marc 7:37; ἑορτὴν π. (Dem., Exode 23:16, al.), Actes 18:21, Rec.; πάσχα, Matthieu 26:18; to make or offer a sacrifice (Plat., Xen., al.; Job 42:8, 3Ki.11:33; so some understand τοῦτο ποιεῖτε, Luc 22:19, but see Abbott, Essays, 110ff.); before ἵνα (WM, 422f.; M, Pr., 228), Jean 11:37, Colossiens 4:16, Apocalypse 3:9. 
__2. to do, perform, carry out, execute: absol., with adv., καλῶς π., Matthieu 12:12, 1 Corinthiens 7:37, 38 Jacques 2:19; id. before ptcp. (cl.; see M, Pr., 228), Actes 10:33, Philippiens 4:14, 2 Pierre 1:19, 3Jo.6; οὕτως, Matthieu 24:46, Luc 9:15, al.; ὡς (καθώς), Matthieu 1:24 2:16, al.; ὁμοίως, Luc 3:11; ὡσαύτως, Matthieu 20:5; with ptcp., ἀγνοῶν ἐποίησα, 1 Timothée 1:13; with accusative of thing(s): τί interrog., Matthieu 12:3, Marc 2:25, Luc 6:2, al.; τοῦτο, Matthieu 13:28, Marc 5:32, Luc 22:19 (WH om.; see supr., ref. to Abbott, Essays), Romains 7:20, al.; with nouns expressing command or regulation: τ. νόμον (not as in cl., to make a law), Jean 7:19, Galates 5:3 (cf. in LXX, Josué 22:5, 1 Chroniques 22:12, al.); τ. ἐντολάς, Matthieu 5:19; similarly with other nouns expressing conduct: τ. δικαιοσύνην, Matthieu 6:1, al.; τ. ἀλήθειαν, Jean 3:21, al., etc.; with dupl. accusative, Matthieu 27:22, Marc 15:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s) (commod., incomm.; rare in cl.), Matthieu 7:12, Marc 5:19, 20 Luc 1:49, Jean 9:26, al. 
SYN.: πράσσω, which see The general distinction between the two words is that between particular action and its habitual performance (cf. Tr., Syn., §xcvi; Westc. on Jean 3:21; ICC on Romains 1:32).

__2. to do, perform, carry out, execute: absol., with adv., καλῶς π., Matthieu 12:12, 1 Corinthiens 7:37, 38 Jacques 2:19; id. before ptcp. G4161.def:
ποίημα, -τος, τό
(ποιέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַעֲשֶׂה (frequently in Ec) ;] 
that which is made or done, a work: Romains 1:20, Éphésiens 2:10.†

G4163.def:
ποιητής, -οῦ ὁ
(ποιέω), [in LXX: 1Ma.2:67 * ;] 
in cl., 
__1. a maker, author. 
__2. Esp., a poet: Actes 17:28. Later, 
__3. a doer: τ. νόμου, Romains 2:13, Jacques 4:11 (1Mac, l.with); ἔργου, Jacques 1:25; λόγου, ib. Jacques 1:22-23.†

G4164.def:
ποικίλος, -η, -ον 
[in LXX for נָקֹד, רִקְמָה, etc. ;] 
many-coloured, variegated. Metaphorical, various, manifold: Matthieu 4:24, Marc 1:34, Luc 4:40, 2 Timothée 3:6, Tite 3:3, Hébreux 2:4 13:9, Jacques 1:2, 1 Pierre 1:6 4:10.†

G4165.def:
ποιμαίνω
(ποιμήν), [in LXX chiefly for רָעָה ;] 
to act as shepherd, tend flocks: Luc 17:7; with accusative, ποιμνην, 1 Corinthiens 9:7. Metaphorical, to tend, shepherd, govern: with accusative, Matthieu 2:6 (LXX), Jean 21:16, Actes 20:28, 1 Pierre 5:2, Ju 12, Apocalypse 2:27 7:17 12:5 19:15.†
SYN.: βόσκω, q.v

G4166.def:
ποιμήν, -ίνος, ὁ 
[in LXX for רָעָה ;] 
a shepherd: Matthieu 9:36 25:32 26:31" (LXX), Marc 6:34 14:27, Luc 2:8, 15 2:18, 20 Jean 10:2, 12 Metaphorical, of Christ; Jean 10:11, 14 10:16 Hébreux 13:20, 1 Pierre 2:25; of Christian pastors, Éphésiens 4:11 (cf. Hom., Il, i, 263, ποιμένα λαῶν).†

G4167.def:
ποίμνη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Genèse 32:16 (17) (עֵדֶר), Zacharie 13:7 A * ;] 
a flock, prop., of sheep: Matthieu 26:31, Luc 2:8, 1 Corinthiens 9:7. Metaphorical, of Christ's followers, Jean 10:16.†

G4168.def:
ποίμνιον, -ου, τό, = ποίμνη, which see 
[in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for עֵדֶר, etc. ;] 
a flock, prop., of sheep. Metaphorical, of Christians: Luc 12:32, Actes 20:23, 28, 1 Pierre 5:3; τ. θεοῦ, ib. 1 Pierre 5:2.†

G4170.def:
πολεμέω, -ῶ
(πόλεμος), [in LXX chiefly for לָחַם ni. ;] 
to make war, fight: Apocalypse 12:7 b Apocalypse 19:11; before μετά (2 Rois 21:15 and see M, Pr., 106, 247), Apocalypse 2:16 12:7 a Apocalypse 13:4 17:14; hyperb., of private quarrels, Jacques 4:2.†

G4171.def:
πόλεμος, -ον, ό 
[in LXX chiefly for מִלְחָמָה ;] 
__1. war: Matthieu 24:6, Marc 13:7, Luc 14:31 21:9, Hébreux 11:34; π. ποιεῖν, before μετά, with genitive (cf. πολεμέω), Apocalypse 11:7 12:17 13:7 19:19. 
__2. = μάχη, a fight, battle: 1 Corinthiens 14:8, Apocalypse 9:7, 9 12:7 16:14 20:8; hyperb., of private quarrels (cf. πολεμέω), Jacques 4:1.†

G4172.def:
πόλις, -εως, ὁ, 
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for עִיר ;] 
a city: Matthieu 2:23, Marc 1:45, Luc 4:29, Jean 4:8, al. mult.; opposite to κῶμαι (κ. καὶ ἀγροί), Matthieu 9:35 10:11, Marc 6:56, Luc 8:1 13:22; with nom. propr. in appos. (cl.), Actes 11:5 16:14; with id. in genitive appos. (BL, §35, 5), Actes 8:5, 2 Pierre 2:6; genitive, of the region, Luc 1:26 4:31, Jean 4:5; of the inhabitants, Matthieu 10:5, 23 Luc 23:51, Actes 19:35, 2 Corinthiens 11:32; with genitive of person(s), of one's residence or native place, Matthieu 22:7, Luc 2:4, 11 4:29 10:11, Jean 1:45, Actes 16:20, Apocalypse 16:9; of Jerusalem: ἡ ἁγία π., Matthieu 4:5 27:53, Apocalypse 11:2; ἡ ἠγαπημένη, Apocalypse 20:19; π. τοῦ μεγάλου, Mt 5 ̈35 (cf. Ps 47 (48):2); of the heavenly city in the Apocalyptic visions, Apocalypse 3:12 21:2, 10 14ff. 22:14, 19. By meton., of the inhabitants of a city: Matthieu 8:34 12:25 21:10, Marc 1:33, Actes 14:21 21:30.

G4173.def:
πολιτάρχης, -ου, ὁ 
= πολίαρχος (Pind., Eur.), 
the ruler of a city, a politarch: Actes 17:6, 8 (see MM, xx).†

G4174.def:
πολιτεία, -ας, ἡ
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:11 2Mac 6:23 2Mac 8:17 2Mac 13:14, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 3:23, 4Ma.3:20 4Mac 8:7 4Mac 17:9 * ;] 
__1. citizenship: Actes 22:28 (3 Mac, ll. with, Hdt., Xen., a1.). 
__2. government, administration (Aristoph., Dem., al.). 
__3. a commonwealth: Éphésiens 2:12.†

G4175.def:
πολίτευμα, -τος, τό
(πολιτεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:7 * ;] 
__1. an act of administration. 
__2. a form of government. 
__3. = πολιτεία, 
__(a) citizenship : Philippiens 3:20 (R, txt.); 
__(b) community, commonwealth : Phi, l.with (R, mg.; for exx, see MM, xx).†

G4176.def:
πολιτεύω more frequently as depon., -ομαι, and so in LXX and NT 
(πολίτης), [in LXX: Esther 8:13, 2Ma.6:1 2Mac 11:25, 3Ma.3:4 3Mac 3:1-30; 4Ma.4:1-26 * ;] 
to be a citizen, live as a citizen: metaphorically, of conduct as based on heavenly citizenship, Actes 23:1, Philippiens 1:27.†

G4177.def:
πολίτης, -ου, ὁ
(πόλις), [in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ ;] 
__1. a citizen: with genitive loc., Luc 15:15, Actes 21:39. 
__2. a fellow-citizen: with genitive of person(s), Luc 19:14, Hébreux 8:11" (LXX) .†

G4179.def:
πολλαπλασίων, -ον
(πόλυς), 
= πολλαπλάσιος, 
many times more: Matthieu 19:29, Luc 18:30.†
ἑπταπλασίων, -ον, 
genitive, -ονος, 
[in LXX for שִׁבְעָתַיִם, Psaumes 79:12, al. ;] 
sevenfold: Luc 18:30 (WH, mg., for πολλαπλ- WH, txt., RV; see WH, Notes, 62).†

G4180.def:
πολυλογία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX: Proverbes 10:19 (דָּבָר רֹב)* ;] 
much speaking, loquacity: Matthieu 6:7.†

G4181.def:
πολυμερῶς 
adv. (πολύς, μέρος), 
in many parts or portions: Hébreux 1:1 (Plut., al.).†

G4182.def:
πολυ-ποίκιλος, -ον 
__1. much variegated, of greatly differing colours (Eur.). 
__2. manifold: Éphésiens 3:10.†

G4183.def:
πολύς, πολλή, πολύ, 
[in LXX chiefly for רַב and cognate forms ;] 
__1. as adj., much, many, great, of number, space, degree, value, time, etc.: ἀριθμός, Actes 11:21; ὄχλος, Marc 5:24; θερισμός, Matthieu 9:37; χόρτος, Jean 6:10; χρόνος, Matthieu 25:19; γογγυσμός, Jean 7:12; πόνος, Colossiens 4:13; δόξα, Matthieu 24:30; σιγή, Actes 21:40; pl., προφῆται, Matthieu 13:17; ὄχλοι, Matthieu 4:25; δαιμόνια, Marc 1:34; δυνάμεις, Matthieu 7:22, 
__2. As subst., pl. masc, πολλοί, many (persons): Matthieu 7:22, Marc 2:2, al.; with genitive partit., Matthieu 3:7, Luc 1:16, al.; before ἐκ, Jean 7:31, Actes 17:12; with art., οἱ π., the many, Matthieu 24:12, Romains 12:5, 1 Corinthiens 10:17, 33 2 Corinthiens 2:17; opposite to ὁ εἶς (Lft., Notes, 291), Romains 5:15, 19; neut. pl., πολλά: Matthieu 13:3, Marc 5:26, al.; accusative with adverbial force, Marc 1:45, Romains 16:6 (Deiss., LAE, 317), 1 Corinthiens 16:12, Jacques 3:2, al.; neut. sing., πολύ: Luc 12:48; adverbially, Marc 12:27, al.; πολλοῦ (genitive pret.), Matthieu 26:9; with compar. (Bl., §44, 5), π. σπουδαιότερον, 2 Corinthiens 8:22; πολλῷ πλείους, Jean 4:41. 
Compar., πλείων
, neut., πλεῖον and πλέον (see WH, App., 151), pl., πλείονες, -ας, -α, contr., πλείους, -ω (cf. Mayser, 69), more, greater; 
__1. as adj.: Jean 15:2, Actes 18:2o, Hébreux 3:3; before παρά, Hébreux 11:4 (cf. Westc, in l. Was ΠΛΙΟΝΑ here a primitive error for ΗΔΙΟΝΑ ?); pi., Actes 13:31, al.; with genitive compar., Matthieu 21:36; with num. (ἤ of comp. omitted), Actes 4:22 24:11, al. 
__2. As subst., οἱ π., the greater number: Actes 10:32 27:12, 1 Corinthiens 10:5 15:6; also (Bl., §44, 3) others, more, the more: 2 Corinthiens 2:6 4:15, Philippiens 1:14; πλείονα, Luc 11:53; πλειον, πλέον, Matthieu 20:10, 2 Timothée 3:9; with genitive comp., Mk 12:43, Luc 21:3; π. Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε, Matthieu 12:41; adverbially, Actes 4:17 20:9 24:4. 
__3. As adv., πλεῖον: before ἤ, Luc 9:13; with genitive comp., Matthieu 5:20; πλείω: with num., Matthieu 26:53. 
Superl., πλεῖστος, -η, -ον
, __(a) prop., most: Matthieu 11:20 21:8; adverbially, τὸ π., 1 Corinthiens 14:27; 
__(b) elative (M, Pr., 79), very great: ὄχλος π., Marc 4:1.

G4185.def:
πολυτελής, -ές
(πολύς, τέλος) [in LXX for יָקָר, etc. ;] 
very costly, very precious, of great value: Marc 14:3, 1 Timothée 2:9; metaphorically, 1 Pierre 3:4.†

G4186.def:
πολύτιμος, -ον
(πολύς, τιμή) 
__1. much revered (Menand.). 
__2. very costly, very precious: Matthieu 13:46 26:7 (βαρύτιμος, WH), Jean 12:3; comparat., 1 Pierre 1:7.†

G4187.def:
πολυτρόπως 
adv. (πολύτροπος, 1. much turning. 2. manifold ), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:21 A * ;] 
in many ways or manners: Hébreux 1:1 (Philo).†

G4188.def:
πόμα, -τος, τό
(πίνω), 
late form of Att.. πῶμα, 
[in LXX.: Psaumes 102:9 (שִׁקּוּי), al. 4 * ;] 
drink: 1 Corinthiens 10:4, Hébreux 9:10.†

G4189.def:
πονηρία, -ας, ἡ
(πονηρός), [in LXX chiefly for רַע ;] 
iniquity, wickedness: Matthieu 22:18, Luc 11:39, Romains 1:29, Éphésiens 6:12; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), Marc 7:22, Actes 3:26; κακία καὶ π., 1 Corinthiens 5:8.†
SYN.: see: κακία.

G4192.def:
πόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for עָמָל, etc. ;] 
__1. labour, toil: Colossiens 4:13 
__2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain (Xen., al., LXX): Apocalypse 16:10-11 21:4.†
SYN.: see: κόπος

G4193.def: from Pontus, Pontic , (Iliad by Homer) δένδρεον, probably, the bird-cherry , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4194.def:
Πόντιος, -ου, ὁ 
Pontius, the prænomen of Pilate (see: Πειλᾶτος), Matthieu 27:2 (Rec., WH, mg.), Luc 3:1, Actes 4:27, 1 Timothée 6:13.†

G4195.def:
Πόντος, -ου, ὁ 
Pontus, a region of Asia Minor, bordering on the πόντος Εὔξεινος: Actes 2:9, 1 Pierre 1:1.†

G4197.def:
πορεία, -ας, ἡ
(πορεύω), [in LXX chiefly for הֲלִיכָה and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. a journey: Luc 13:22. 
__2. a going: metaphorically ("the rich man perishes while he is still on the move," Hort., in l), Jacques 1:11.†

G4199.def:
πορθέω collat. form (in cl. chiefly poët.) of πέρθω, 
[in LXX: 4Ma.4:23 4Mac 11:4 * ;] 
to destroy, ravage: Actes 9:21, Galates 1:13, 23.†
